name: Volcengine Ark
description: ByteDance's model platform: a free token block for every model, for 30 days.
overview: Volcengine Ark is ByteDance's model API platform, hosting the Doubao/Seed family plus third-party models such as DeepSeek and GLM behind an OpenAI-compatible SDK. Each model comes with its own 500,000-token free block for new accounts, valid 30 days, and a "peace of mind" mode that stops serving instead of billing once the block runs out. Registration needs real-name verification and a mainland payment method.
notes: Requires real-name verification and a mainland payment method; blocks are per model.
